The Staffordshire Bull Terrier evolved in the 19th century in the Black Country of England, primarily from the crossing of the Bulldog and various terriers — breed history is the breed guide's (Task 12), not an about page's.

Key considerations include committing to early socialization, consistent positive training, and providing plenty of exercise. — first-time-owner advice belongs to the buying guide and the blog guides, both of which this page links. The RSPCA's own puppy advice is linked from `home-raising` in its place.
